name: FileUpload
title: FileUpload
summary: A dashed drop zone with a "browse" link over a real file input, followed by a list of file rows that show upload progress, success or a plain-language error.
whenToUse: Applications and orders that need a document or photo: Broadcast partner application (station licence, tower photo), publishing artwork, a church logo for NFC cards.
One or more files up to a stated size and type.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a profile avatar crop or a camera capture inside the dot.Bible app; use the platform picker there.

props.name: prompt
props.description: Text before the browse button, for example "Drag your station licence here, or".

props.name: browseLabel
props.description: Text of the browse button that opens the real file input, for example "browse".

props.name: hint
props.description: Accepted types and the size limit, for example "PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 10 MB each". Linked to the browse button.

props.name: dragOverLabel
props.description: Title while files are dragged over, for example (n) => "Drop to upload · 2 files". Receives the file count (0 when unknown).

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the chosen or dropped files. The component does no uploading: update `items` yourself.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows shown under the drop zone, in the order given.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove a done or failed row.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Text of the Retry button, for example "Retry". Required for the retry action to show.

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the file list, for example "Uploaded files".

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for accessible names and announcements (English defaults).

props.name: accept
props.description: `accept` attribute of the file input, for example ".pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png".

props.name: inputId
props.description: `id` of the file input. Generated when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: `name` of the file input for native form posts.

variantNotes: Default: dashed border; hover darkens it to `--gray-600`.
Drag-over (`.fm-over`): solid `--horizon-blue` border on `--blue-tint`; icon tile turns solid blue, the arrow points down and the title reads "Drop to upload" with the file count.
Uploading: neutral icon tile, "1.8 MB of 2.8 MB · 64%" and the progress bar; action is cancel (×).
Done: `.fm-file-ic.fm-ok` green check tile, `.fm-file-meta.fm-ok` "Uploaded · 2.4 MB"; action is remove (bin).
Error: `.fm-file.fm-err` tinted row with `--error-line` border, `.fm-file-ic.fm-bad` and `.fm-file-meta.fm-bad`; actions are Retry (`.btn-ghost .btn-sm`) and remove.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always keep a real `<input type="file">` behind the "browse" button; the drop zone is an extra, never the only way.
State accepted types and the size limit in the `.hint` line under the title.
Add rows under the drop zone in the order files were added; never reorder them.
Errors say what went wrong and what to do ("14.2 MB is over the 10 MB limit. Try a smaller file.").
Use status colours only for done (`--success`) and error (`--error`); progress is `--horizon-blue`.
Icon buttons are 44px round targets; never shrink them to the icon size.
On phones, hide "Drag your … here" and show a single "Choose file" `.btn-secondary`.

accessibility: The "browse" button opens the file input; the drop zone itself is not a tab stop.
Progress bars have `role="progressbar"`, `aria-valuenow` and a name that includes the file name.
Announce each finished or failed file in a polite live region ("tower-site-photo.jpg uploaded").
Icon buttons are named with the file: "Remove tower-site-photo.jpg", "Cancel upload".
Do not rely on colour alone: the error row also has the alert icon and the reason text.
